$comment: Check catalog. report.py evaluates every check from stage outputs (never from prose) and maps the result to a severity with these rules. `title` is the pass condition (check table); `fail_title` names the failure (findings). Findings count defects, not restatements: A1 and checks whose cases are all classified REGRESSION are rows only; checklist failures, classifications and case-level check failures that link (`finding`) or cite the same cases as an analysis finding fold into it, with the worst severity of what folded. Verdict: any BLOCKER -> UNSAFE; else any MAJOR -> NEEDS_CHANGES; else any MINOR -> SAFE_WITH_NITS; else SAFE. INCONCLUSIVE replaces SAFE/SAFE_WITH_NITS when a required stage did not run, analysis.json is incomplete, or a check is INCONCLUSIVE (the oracle could not run on what it needs). NEEDS_MAINTAINER_DECISION and the O10 decision bucket never make a verdict UNSAFE: a decision is MAJOR only when the browsers show head worse than base, otherwise a NOTE. T6 is a NOTE for an assertion on a probe that a PRE_EXISTING classification or FAIL_PRE_EXISTING answer names, directly or through the finding it links (base passes it only by being wrong another way). When every delta needs a flag the PR adds (corpus flag_only), the verdict carries the scope `flag <x> only`.
